name: 3985-shortdecode-commandr35b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 (four GPUs of one a3 node).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1 -- ~70 GB of fp16 weights do not fit one 80 GB card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 8 streams, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 480 requests with a 1800 s safety cap -- roughly 384 measured requests.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain`, fixed by construction: every request is exactly 32 prompt tokens and exactly 128 output tokens (min=max on both), sampled at temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, n=1 with ignore_eos set.
purpose: A 35-billion-parameter multilingual chat assistant giving short replies to brief prompts for eight concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.4.0.post1-52-g67b4221a61ace, a source checkout of commit
# 67b4221a61ace91a79aff507df0a95a01978300e. Nothing here is tuned.
# TP>1 on this engine is driven by the Ray executor, so `ray` must import in the venv;
# a missing ray is the way a TP4 run of this era fails first.

# An ungated public mirror of `CohereLabs/c4ai-command-r-v01` with the identical geometry; the
# original's licence (CC-BY-NC 4.0, with C4AI's Acceptable Use Policy) applies. Not in the local
# cache -- it downloads on first run (~70 GB).
model: adalbertojunior/c4ai-command-r-v01

tensor-parallel-size: 4
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
